sequences.name: Celery Man
sequences.prompt: Celery Man: an ordinary, slightly awkward office worker in his thirties with short neat hair, wearing a baggy grey early-1990s suit with big shoulders, a white shirt, a celery-green tie and sensible brown shoes. Dance: an earnest side-to-side office-party shuffle, stepping left and right with stiff arms and a shy, concentrated face

sequences.name: Oyster
sequences.prompt: Oyster: a cheerful person in their late twenties wearing a shiny pearl-grey satin shirt, dark slacks, black shoes and a pearl necklace. Dance: a smooth, happy groove, swaying the hips and shoulders and snapping the fingers

sequences.name: Tayne
sequences.prompt: Tayne: a flamboyant stage entertainer in his forties wearing a sparkly teal sequinned jumpsuit, white boots and a very large wide-brimmed dark navy hat sitting clearly on top of his head. Dance: a confident strut on the spot, swinging the hips and rolling the shoulders
